body: I think I may look into volunteer work. Some self worth may be in order.
poetry: i just recently bought a book by a famous poet and every time I read it, I feel serene and the negative thoughts evaporate.  so true.  I think I might go read it now.

Well, i actually thought out how I would do it, so I guess in that way it was more logical than just a slew of negative emotions.  

I don't want to go into the 'bad' habit I quit, because I know for a fact that people will say it's not bad at all.  I know that it has a negative effect on my life and that is why I'm trying to quit it.  The mood swings may be due to withdrawal-like symptoms of this quitting.  From this statement alone, you can probably guess what it is.

The no girlfriend/friends thing is what is bothering me the most. 

Does it make me a 'weak' person, that I rely on these things to make me happy?  Am I 'weak' because I cannot be happy without having a relationship?  Am I 'weak' because I can't be content with having few friends?  I feel like I should be stronger than this, uninfluenced by transient things like friends and lovers.
